name: SonarQube Quality Hub
description: A modern read-only SonarQube workspace with project switching, analysis history, issue filtering and global quality insights.
releaseNotes: Fixed the DBX sandboxed Workbench runtime so connection settings and all actions work without localStorage, and added complete light/dark theme support using the host data-dbx-theme tokens. Keeps the read-only PostgreSQL workspace, issue explorer, snapshots and global statistics.
